title: Web app or native app: which one does your business actually need?

points.heading: When a web app is enough
points.body: A web app is the right answer more often than the market suggests, and it's the cheapest thing to change after launch.

points.heading: What native actually buys you
points.body: Native earns its extra cost when you need things a browser handles badly or not at all:

cta.headline: The full piece is on the site.
cta.sub: Most business apps don't need to be native.

card.quote: Most business apps don't need to be native.
